Your Trusted British Male Voiceover Artist

Need a British male voiceover that hits the mark every time?

From TV commercials and narration to animation, live events, and game trailers, I deliver voiceovers tailored to each unique project. I’ve voiced Salty in Thomas & Friends, narrated documentaries, and served as the Voice of God for global events like the International Gaming Awards.

Need something natural and sincere? Or a bold character voice that steals the show? Whether you’re after friendly, formal, funny or full-blown drama, I’ve got it covered.

As a seasoned British male voiceover artist, I’ve adapted my delivery across countless industries – tech, retail, entertainment, education, finance, always keeping the end result crisp, compelling, and bang on brief. I'm happy with thousands of words too.

faqseo2.faqs1:
Voiceover Frequently Asked Questions

Quick answers to the most common questions about working with Guy Harris, an award-winning British male voiceover artist. If you're not sure how usage works, how fast you can get your audio, or how live-directed sessions operate, you'll find the essentials below.
faqseo2.faqs2:
How quickly can you deliver a voiceover?
Most voiceovers are delivered within 24 hours — and many are completed the same day within 2 hours. I’m in the studio every day, so fast turnaround is standard, especially for projects like explainer videos.
faqseo2.faqs3:
Can I direct the voiceover session live?
Yes — you can direct the session live in real time. I offer remote direction via Cleanfeed, Source-Connect, Nexus, Zoom, Teams or even a simple phone patch. Everything is recorded in my broadcast-quality booth, the same space used for professional studio hire, so you can hear the read clearly and sign it off as we go.
faqseo2.faqs4:
What’s the benefit of using your AI voice instead of a human recording?
My AI voice, GuyAi, is ideal for projects that need fast turnaround, frequent updates, or multiple versions — such as explainer videos, eLearning modules or internal comms. It delivers a consistent tone, saves time, and fits seamlessly into large-scale workflows. For emotional reads or performance-led scripts, most clients still prefer the human me. You can hear the difference and read more about both options here: AI voice vs human voiceover.
faqseo2.faqs5:
You do a good David Attenborough?
I'd like to think so — it’s one of my most requested character styles. I’m regularly booked for my David Attenborough–inspired narration for adverts, games, social campaigns and spoof documentaries. You can hear demos and see recent projects on my David Attenborough style voiceover page. Always happy to record a quick sample if you want to hear how it would sound for your script.
faqseo2.faqs6:
Are you the voice of Santa and Father Christmas?
Yes – My Voice of Santa is heard on BBC Radio 2, The Heart Network, Capital, Butlins, ITV, GB News, Tesco, Asda and many more. You can also check out Santa Guy for more on my Santa or Santa Radio for the Live Christmas Radio Station playing a traditional British Christmas.
faqseo2.faqs7: VoiceoverGuy FAQs – Answers of Rates, Usage & Delivery
faqseo2.faqs8: Got questions about voiceovers, studio setup, delivery, or licensing? Check out the VoiceoverGuy FAQ for clear answers and expert advice on every step.
faqseo2.faqs9:
Have I heard you on the television?
Quite possibly, yes. I’ve voiced countless TV promos and competition spots over the years. If you watched Britain’s Got Talent recently, you’ll have heard me — I was the competition voice for the whole series. You can hear examples on my Britain’s Got Talent competition voice page.
faqseo2.faqs10:
Do you charge for any revisions?
Yes. If I’ve misread something or it’s clearly wrong, I’ll fix it. If you've changed the whole script, there may be small fee. But let's take a look.
faqseo2.faqs11:
What formats do you deliver?
WAV, MP3, AIFF – whatever you need to be honest. I can also provide split files, labelled audio, or specific bitrates if you're working to a technical spec.
faqseo2.faqs12:
Are you expensive?
If you’re looking for the cheapest option, then no — I’m probably not the right fit. But if you want over two decades’ experience, a full-time professional studio, fast turnaround and work that sounds right first time, my rates reflect that level of quality. There’s more on why clients continue to book me on my Why Use VoiceoverGuy page.
faqseo2.faqs13:
What is your turnaround time?
It's... - Same day in most cases, within 24 hours guaranteed on standard work.
